q1_t013_cache_representation.answer: Causally resampled (250 Hz) and causally filtered float64 ECG, DELIBERATELY NOT z-score normalized.
q1_t013_cache_representation.evidence: configs/preproc_v1.yaml normalization.cache_policy == 'FILTERED_UNNORMALIZED_CANONICAL_CACHE'; empirically verified on a real cached window (mean approx 0.0006, std approx 0.193, not unit variance).

q2_normalization_helper_and_formula.answer: preprocessing/windowing.py::normalize_window_zscore(values, *, epsilon=NORMALIZATION_EPSILON) -- (signal - population_mean(signal)) / (population_std(signal, ddof=0) + epsilon), CURRENT_WINDOW_ONLY fit scope, dataset/patient statistics FORBIDDEN.

q4_q5_normalized_by_task.evidence: grep -n normalize_window_zscore across these files: each calls preprocessing.windowing.normalize_window_zscore on cached/raw windows before any model/gateway inference call.

q6_gatewaymodelruntime_normalizes.evidence: deployment/runtime.py::GatewayModelRuntime docstring: 'Strict batch-one CPU runtime; preprocessing remains upstream.' validate_input() only checks dtype/shape/finiteness, never mean/std. No 'normalize' token anywhere in the file.

q7_old_productionruntime_normalizes.evidence: api/runtime.py::ProductionRuntime.infer() builds `np.asarray(ecg_samples, dtype=np.float32).reshape(1,1,-1)` and calls self.gateway.infer(array) directly -- zero calls to normalize_window_zscore or any normalization helper anywhere in the file.

q8_run_replay_normalizes.evidence: scripts/run_replay.py and scripts/build_replay_fixture_t034.py contain no 'normalize' token; both copy the TRAIN cache's filtered_windows.npy values directly (cast to float32) into the request body.

q9_frontend_bundle_normalizes.evidence: scripts/build_frontend_replay_bundle_c034.py reads the same frozen NPZ and writes samples unchanged (astype(np.float64).tolist()); no normalization call.

q10_first_path_dropping_normalization.answer: api/runtime.py::ProductionRuntime.infer() (introduced at T032). This is the single, narrow root cause: every consumer upstream of it (T015-T031) correctly normalizes before touching MODEL_V1/the gateway; api/runtime.py is the first and only production code path that hands GatewayModelRuntime an unnormalized window. api/schemas.py::ECGWindow's docstring compounds the error by incorrectly documenting the incoming request body as already 'GATEWAY_MODEL_INPUT_V1'-ready (it is resampled+filtered, but never normalized) -- this is a docstring/comment error, not a claim made by the frozen contracts/API_SCHEMA_V1.json JSON Schema itself, which carries no such semantic claim.
downstream_of_api_runtime_v1_also_affect: frontend dashboard demo-window.ts (flat-zero, happens to be invariant under z-scoring so no observable symptom)
